name: base
purpose: reset at power-up with a sig rise inside it and a release while sig is high (no qualification); a plain 12 ns qualification and a falling clear; a glitch burst whose cancelled qualifications end while sig is high again (stale completions at 77.02 and 85.02 ns must not fire); reset while the output is high and a release with sig high; a 2 ns reset pulse inside a qualification; falls 0.3 ns before and 0.3 ns after a completion (the second interrupts the rising output)
